baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated clauses "فوقاه ... سيئات" and "وحاق ... سوء العذاب" oppose guarding one person to enclosing Pharaoh's collective.
baseline_models.mechanism: A harm-deflecting barrier blocks the plotted evils at the believer, while the same semantic field of distress is redirected into descending enclosure and punitive pain around the other party.

activation_trace.role: Deflecting harm by a protective barrier supplies the blocked trajectory at the opening of the ayah.
What causes distress links the plotted evils with the badness predicated of the punishment.
The descent and enclosure of harm supplies the opposite, successful trajectory around Pharaoh's group.
The people attached to and referring back to a man make Pharaoh's relational collective the receiving field.
Inflicted pain and punishment specify what the enclosing badness does to that collective.

changed_reading.before: God saved the believer from their plots, and Pharaoh's people were punished.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages opposed trajectories: plotted harms are intercepted at the believer, then punitive badness descends and closes around the plotting collective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split-root inventory attached to "بآل فرعون" permits both a household/follower relation and a continuity-of-governance resonance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object of enclosure is not only a biological household. It is a Pharaoh-centered field of attachment, succession, and administration, so the punishment reaches the social order organized by his headship.

activation_trace.role: Kin, dependents, and followers who return to a man provide the ordinary collective core of آل.
Uninterrupted succession adds a chain-like social continuity to the group named after Pharaoh.
Taking charge of an affair supplies the governing relation that holds the Pharaoh-centered order together.
Enclosure makes the whole affiliation field, rather than only isolated individuals, the spatial target.

changed_reading.after: Bad punishment enclosed the Pharaoh-centered network of kinship, following, succession, and rule.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier prayer language asks for guarding from punishment and from evils, then explicitly equates such guarding with mercy and deliverance. The completed "فوقاه" makes the focus event a narrative instantiation of that prayer-shaped protection.

activation_trace.role: The petition for a harm-deflecting barrier supplies the prospective form later realized in the focus verb.
Painful punishment names the threatened field from which the petition asks protection.
The doubled guarding construction makes protection from evils a defined operation rather than a one-off escape.
Repeated distressing evils supply the same object frame used by the focus ayah.
Merciful tenderness interprets successful guarding positively, beyond bare survival.
Attaining good through deliverance supplies the outcome-value of being guarded.
The completed protective act converts the earlier petition's operation into narrated fact.

structural_cues: 40:7 and 40:9 formulate protection prospectively; 40:45 uses the same root in a completed narrative clause.
The focus pair of guarding plus evils closely repeats the lexical pairing in 40:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated وقي plus عذاب/سيئات frame and labels its result mercy and deliverance; I infer that 40:45 deliberately realizes that frame in one believer. A live alternative is that the repetition marks a general divine pattern without making the earlier prayer a direct narrative antecedent.

changed_reading.before: The believer happens to escape a local plot.
changed_reading.after: His escape is a concrete instance of the surah's earlier definition of guarded mercy and deliverance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first denies a protecting barrier to powerful peoples when God seizes them and denies a restraining protector to those who flee. Against those absences, the explicit subject "الله" in the focus ayah becomes decisive: protection exists here because God supplies it, not because the believer has institutional shelter.

activation_trace.role: The denied harm-deflecting protector establishes that worldly power cannot erect the needed barrier.
A preserving restraint that is explicitly unavailable sharpens the asymmetry between the fleeing group and the guarded believer.
The actually supplied barrier marks the focus protection as exceptional in source, not merely in result.

structural_cues: 40:21 negates any واق after divine seizure, and 40:33 negates any عاصم during flight.
40:45 names Allah as the grammatical agent of the protection denied elsewhere.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two explicit protector-negations and one explicit divine guarding; I infer that their contrast foregrounds exclusive agency. The alternative is that the negations concern final judgment while 40:45 concerns temporal rescue, so the contrast may be analogical rather than identical in scope.

changed_reading.before: God is simply the agent who saves him.
changed_reading.after: The named divine agent is the point: the one barrier unavailable to imperial power is supplied to the exposed believer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context gives scheming a lethal policy and a built apparatus, then evaluates Pharaoh's intrigue as deviation, loss, and ruin before the focus rescue occurs. The focus "ما مكروا" can therefore denote harms produced by a worked imperial project whose own trajectory is already failure, rather than a nearly successful private trick canceled at the last moment.

activation_trace.role: Explicit intrigue and contrivance classify the lethal policy as the same functional action-type as the focus plotting.
Deviation from the intended goal gives the scheme an internally misdirected trajectory.
The high constructed tower materializes Pharaoh's policy as an engineered project.
A rope or connective means supplies the projected route by which the engineered scheme claims it can reach its target.
The repeated connector extends the tower project into an apparatus of claimed access.
The ugliness and bad quality of Pharaoh's work anticipates the focus phrase "سيئات ما مكروا".
Pharaoh's named intrigue directly identifies the surrounding project as contrivance.
Loss and destruction state the scheme's endpoint before the focus ayah narrates protection from it.
Preparing hard ground by watering supplies an exploratory material image of plotting as worked preparation.

structural_cues: 40:25 joins a killing command to the judgment that disbelievers' كيد is in ضلال.
40:36-37 narrates Pharaoh's building command and twice names its reaching-means before judging his كيد to be in تباب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lethal state policy, an engineered Pharaoh project, and explicit verdicts of deviation and ruin; I group these as the operating background of "ما مكروا" and read the focus rescue as non-capture by that apparatus. A narrower live alternative restricts "ما مكروا" to an unreported immediate scheme against the believer.

changed_reading.before: A successful secret plan is externally defeated just before it reaches him.
changed_reading.after: He is kept outside the harms of a worked imperial apparatus whose apparent reach is already structurally deviation and ruin.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus ayah, the believer returns management of his affair to God in reliance on Him and names God as seeing the servants. The following guarding can be read as the narrative counterpart of transferred agency: the exposed speaker ceases to manage the threat, and the fully seeing addressee manages its harmful reach.

activation_trace.role: Returning an affair to another in reliance on that party supplies the transfer of management immediately before protection.
Direct seeing supplies complete awareness on the side receiving the delegated affair.
The protective barrier is the next narrated operation performed by the party to whom the affair was returned.

structural_cues: 40:44 and 40:45 are joined by consecutive fa-marked clauses: entrustment is followed by guarding.
Allah is the endpoint of the entrustment in 40:44 and the explicit agent of guarding in 40:45.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate sequence, shared divine participant, delegated affair, seeing, and guarding; I supply the arrow that entrustment occasions the narrated protection. The live alternative is non-transactional: 40:44 expresses the believer's posture while 40:45 independently reports God's rescue.

changed_reading.before: The rescue is a divine intervention with no narrated human posture attached.
changed_reading.after: The rescue answers an immediately prior transfer of the threatened affair from the exposed speaker to the fully seeing divine manager.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel repeats Pharaoh's آل and punishment, then unfolds enclosure into recurrent exposure morning and evening followed by entry into a more intense phase at the Hour. "حاق" thus reads as a temporally layered condition that has already closed around the group, not only a punctual strike.

activation_trace.role: Descending enclosure supplies the summary condition that the next ayah distributes across recurring and final phases.
Being brought out and exposed to view turns enclosure into a repeatedly staged encounter with the fire.
Departure at the beginning of day supplies one recurring temporal edge of the exposure.
Evening time supplies the answering edge, making the exposure cyclic rather than momentary.
The repeated Pharaoh-attached household and follower group fixes the sequel to the same collective target.
The repeated painful punishment, now intensified, specifies the later phase of the enclosing condition.

structural_cues: 40:46 immediately follows the summary in 40:45 and repeats both آل فرعون and العذاب.
40:46 contrasts a morning-evening recurrence with a subsequent command at the Hour.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, the repeated collective and punishment, and an explicit two-stage schedule; I infer that 40:46 unfolds the manner and duration of 40:45's enclosure. The alternative is that 40:45 closes the rescue episode and 40:46 begins a distinct eschatological report linked only by topic.

changed_reading.before: Bad punishment falls on Pharaoh's people as a single completed event.
changed_reading.after: They are already inside a closed punitive schedule: recurrent exposure fills the interval before an intensified final phase.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dialogue after the focus ayah exposes the internal structure of the enclosed آل: followers appeal to former superiors for sufficiency, the superiors admit common enclosure, and the whole group seeks even one day of reduced punishment. Pharaoh's collective is therefore a failed dependency system whose vertical protections disappear inside the punishment.

activation_trace.role: Dependents and followers attached to a head provide the social body whose internal relations the dialogue exposes.
Governance and taking charge supply the former vertical relation between leaders and dependents.
Allegiance and succession identify the speakers as a following organized behind the arrogant leaders.
Requested sufficiency tests whether the former leaders can still cover any share of their followers' exposure.
Reducing a heavy load gives the minimal relief the enclosed group cannot secure even for one day.
Painful punishment is the common burden under which the prior hierarchy loses protective function.

structural_cues: 40:47-50 follows the naming of آل فرعون and stages followers, arrogant leaders, common enclosure, and a failed request for relief.
The followers ask their leaders for a share of rescue, but the leaders answer that all are together inside it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immediate post-focus dialogue between followers and leaders under one punishment; I infer that it reveals the social anatomy and collapse of the Pharaoh-centered آل. The alternative is that the dialogue generalizes to all arrogant leaders and followers rather than referring narrowly to Pharaoh's group.

changed_reading.before: آل فرعون is a flat collective label for people near Pharaoh.
changed_reading.after: It is a hierarchy of reliance whose leaders, followers, and promised protections become equally enclosed and mutually useless.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later punishment imagery gives the focus enclosure a material grammar: a collar fixes the body, connected rings constrain movement, dragging removes self-direction, and stoking or filling fire completes immersion. "حاق" can carry loss of spatial agency, not merely the fact that punishment happened.

activation_trace.role: Harm descending and enclosing supplies the abstract spatial relation materialized by the later sequence.
Painful punishment anchors the later restraint and fire images back in the focus predicate.
A collar fastening a bodily member turns surrounding harm into fixed bodily constraint.
Connected rings supply an extended enclosure whose parts hold together.
Dragging and extending the body removes self-directed motion inside the restraint.
Igniting and intensifying fire completes the containing medium into which the constrained bodies are driven.

structural_cues: 40:71-72 presents a continuous restraint-dragging-fire sequence within the same surah's punishment discourse.
The sequence moves from enclosure of limbs to forced motion and then immersion in fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus verb's enclosure image and later linked restraint, dragging, and fire images; I infer that the later sequence can concretize the spatial force of "حاق". The alternative is that 40:71-72 concerns a wider class of rejecters and should not be imported as the specific mode of Pharaoh's punishment.

changed_reading.after: Punishment closes their space of action: it fixes, connects, drags, and immerses bodies that can no longer direct themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the surah's end, the same enclosure verb takes as its subject-matter what the rejecters had mocked, so their prior stance returns as their enclosing reality; the closing ayah then names a running way that has passed among servants. This activates a recoil reading in the focus coordination: plotted evils fail at their target and the plotters enter the punitive outcome of their own antagonistic stance.

activation_trace.role: The focus enclosure provides the construction whose reflexive force is clarified by its later repetition.
Repeated descending enclosure shows a rejected object becoming the reality that settles around its rejecters.
Mockery supplies the prior antagonistic act whose object later encloses the actors.
A running, followed way turns the recoil pattern from an isolated coincidence into a recurrent trajectory.
The passing of earlier time and generations gives the recurrent way historical depth.

structural_cues: 40:83 repeats حاق بهم with the formerly mocked object as what encloses them.
40:85 closes the surah by naming a divine سنة that has already passed among prior servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated enclosure construction with explicit act-to-outcome reversal and then a recurrent-way formula; I infer a comparable recoil across the two clauses of 40:45. The live alternative is that the focus punishment is only juxtaposed with the failed plot and is not the identical evil the plotters intended.

changed_reading.before: His rescue and their punishment are two independent outcomes placed side by side.
changed_reading.after: The coordination participates in a recurrent recoil pattern: antagonistic action misses its target and closes around the antagonists as punitive outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form ordinarily functions as plotting while its supplied branch inventory foregrounds watered hard ground and rotten soft fruit. It remains anchored in the focus root and gains contextual purchase from Pharaoh's built project and its stated ruin. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for preparation and corrupt yield, never as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: "ما مكروا" can be pictured as a prepared operation whose bad yield develops from the material on which the plotters work.

activation_trace.role: Watering hard ground before working it supplies the image of deliberate preparation that makes later action possible.
A rotten soft date supplies the latent corrupt yield of what has been prepared.
The high built structure gives the preparation image a visible state-project analogue.
Loss and destruction supply the spoiled yield toward which the project develops.

changed_reading.before: Their plot is an abstract intention or secret calculation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is a worked substrate: prepared for harmful production, yet ripening into its own corrupt and ruined yield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The restraint branch is distant from the ordinary punishment sense, which remains explicit in the same focus inventory. It stays anchored in "العذاب" and is sharpened by the later failed request for even one day of lightening. Render it as a secondary texture of unrelieved deprivation, not as an etymological definition of punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The badness in "سوء العذاب" may include being barred from interruption or relief, alongside inflicted pain.

activation_trace.role: Restraint, prevention, and weaning supply the secondary image of access to relief being withheld.
Pain and punishment retain the primary sense and contain the exploratory withholding texture.
The requested reduction of a heavy load identifies interruption and lessening as the unavailable relief.
Failed sufficiency shows that no member of the hierarchy can supply what would cover another's need.

changed_reading.before: The punishment is bad because of the amount of pain it inflicts.
changed_reading.after: Its badness also has an unrelieved structure: pain continues while every route to interruption, reduction, or sufficient help is withheld.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant from the noun's ordinary household/follower function and should not replace that syntax. It remains worth carrying because the packet maps the focus root to a return-and-outcome branch and later states universal return and a historically recurrent way. Downstream prose should mark it as an undertone: the Pharaohic order encountered at its ma'al, not a new dictionary sense for آل.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The mapped return branch under "آل فرعون" lets the enclosed collective faintly resonate as Pharaoh's order at the outcome to which it comes back.

activation_trace.role: Return to an outcome or final state supplies the ma'al resonance within the mapped focus root.
Actual kin and followers keep the resonance attached to the grammatical collective rather than replacing it.
Return to what was before supplies the surah-level motion toward the divine endpoint.
A running historical way frames that endpoint as recurrent for prior orders as well.

changed_reading.before: The phrase names the people socially attached to Pharaoh.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, it also catches the Pharaoh-centered order at its returned outcome, where its social attachment and final ma'al coincide.

strongest_changes: The focus rescue realizes the surah's earlier prayer-definition of guarding from evils as mercy and deliverance.
Immediate entrustment in 40:44 makes the guarding in 40:45 legible as protection following transferred management of the believer's affair.
The sequel turns "حاق" from a punctual strike into a recurring and then intensified punitive schedule around a failed hierarchy.
Repeated judgments of كيد as deviation and ruin recast the focus plot as an imperial apparatus already failing in its direction.
The repeated حاق construction near the close activates a recurrent recoil pattern while stopping short of identifying the plotted evils and punishment as strictly identical.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made a compact rescue clause open simultaneously into prayer fulfillment, exclusive protection, delegated agency, failed state engineering, temporal enclosure, and patronage collapse. The split آل inventory and the materially distant مكر and عذاب branches preserved additional exploratory textures without forcing them into the main reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The sequence from entrustment to guarding supports a causal reading but does not prove a transactional cause.
"ما مكروا" may name the broad Pharaohic apparatus or only an immediate unreported scheme against the believer.
Later restraint and recoil scenes may generalize the focus mechanism without specifying Pharaoh's exact punishment.
The irrigated-corruption, withholding, and ma'al resonances remain branch-driven analogies and should not be rendered as primary lexical meanings.
